title: First Adult High School Graduate!
markdown:
![](http://www.americangroup-international.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/WhatsApp-Image-2019-06-12-at-22.39.01.jpeg)

Younes Hmitou was the first student to take the high school for adults diploma in English. He was awarded his diploma on May 17, 2019.  Congrats to Younes.
